subject.title: feat(android): add Skill Workshop settings panel

question: Should Android Settings expose Skill Workshop proposal review plus apply/reject/quarantine admin actions in this release?
rationale: The implementation reuses existing Gateway RPCs and has convincing proof, but exposing privileged proposal lifecycle controls on mobile is product/owner judgment rather than an automated correctness decision.

options.title: Accept Android parity surface
options.body: Land the panel as implemented, relying on existing Gateway operator.admin enforcement plus the Android client gate for lifecycle actions.

options.title: Ship read-only first
options.body: Keep Android list/inspect/filter support but remove apply/reject/quarantine until mobile admin UX has explicit direction.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause or close this PR until maintainers decide whether Skill Workshop administration belongs in Android Settings.

recommendation.title: Accept Android parity surface
recommendation.body: Land the panel as implemented, relying on existing Gateway operator.admin enforcement plus the Android client gate for lifecycle actions.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current live assignee on the PR and best positioned to make or route the remaining Android product-surface decision.
